title: Persona layers
what: The base persona, the tone layers and the room layers a chat agent carries, with personal values as placeholders a deployment fills in. Lives in layers/, its format in docs/format.md and its receivers in docs/boundary.md.

title: Lore library
what: The lore index, its chunks and the source documents they are cut from, offered to a chat agent as reference pieces. Lives in lore/, its index grammar in docs/format.md and its receivers in docs/boundary.md.
